authored_narrative.episode_purpose: Eleven episodes in, this Story keeps going not because there is more to resolve, but because ordinary days keep happening — and an ordinary day, for two people who have settled fully into a world, is its own kind of narrative worth recording.

scene_spirited_away_no_face_loneliness_0.purpose: The isolation anchor makes one more pass through this Story, entirely stripped of its original weight — a space that would have meant something in Episode 2 now means nothing at all, which is exactly the point.
scene_spirited_away_no_face_loneliness_0.stakes: whether repetition without escalation can still hold a reader's attention
scene_spirited_away_no_face_loneliness_0.opposing_force: none — deliberately. This Story has earned scenes that don't need to fight for their place

scene_spirited_away_guest_hall_0054.purpose: A hall built to impress guests holds nothing remarkable for two people who no longer count as guests — the space's own grandeur has nothing left to say to them.
scene_spirited_away_guest_hall_0054.stakes: whether familiarity eventually flattens even a space designed to be memorable
scene_spirited_away_guest_hall_0054.opposing_force: the hall's architecture itself, still doing its job of being impressive — just no longer to this particular audience

shot_spirited_00409.intent: A plain medium shot, no negative space emphasized, no isolation implied by the framing at all — the visual grammar has fully retired that motif.

shot_spirited_00425.intent: A wide shot that lets the hall's scale register without lingering on it — acknowledged, not marveled at.
